about: iOS keyboard knobs the Android keyboard deliberately does not read, and why. node tools/knobs/extract-keyboard.mjs --parity fails on any iOS knob Android neither reads nor lists here.

The Flow Session: an iOS keyboard cannot use the microphone, so the app holds it in the background. Android records in the keyboard itself.
Handing the mic to the app for one recording: the same iOS restriction.
Retries around UIKit replacing the keyboard's input view.
prefixes.kb.dictation.dim.ios: iOS-tuned dim values. Android reads kb.dictation.dim.blurRadius and kb.dictation.dim.keyAlpha.

values.kb.mic.mode = flow: The iOS default: the app holds the microphone because an iOS keyboard cannot. Android records in the keyboard, so it takes the path features.liveVoice picks.
values.kb.mic.mode = handoff: The app records one capture for the keyboard: the same iOS restriction. Android treats it as flow.

keys.kb.host.traitRefreshMs: Throttles UIKit text-trait reads across the extension boundary. Android gets the field once, in EditorInfo.
keys.kb.mic.resetSecondPassMs: A second pass clearing a UIKit button highlight that sticks after the Flow arm's app switch. Android arms nothing and switches to no app to record.
keys.kb.field.numericKeyboardTypes: UIKit keyboard type names. Android reads the field's inputType class.
keys.kb.secure.contentTypes: UIKit text content types. Android reads the password input variations.
keys.kb.keyPlane.touchColor: The iOS keyboard's touch layer must paint to receive touches: a custom keyboard is composited into the host app and only gets touches where it has drawn. Android views receive touches on transparent pixels.
keys.kb.touch.releaseSystemGestures: UIKit's system gesture gates on the keyboard's window, which delay touches near the screen edges. Android's input view has no such gates.
keys.kb.touch.releaseSystemGestures.ended: The lift half of the same UIKit gates (space and return type on the lift).
keys.kb.touch.deferSystemEdges: UIViewController.preferredScreenEdgesDeferringSystemGestures, a UIKit request with no Android counterpart.
keys.kb.touch.disableEdgePans: UIScreenEdgePanGestureRecognizer in the keyboard window's chain; Android has no edge-pan recognizers over an input view.

labels.full_access_required: iOS Full Access. Android keyboards have no equivalent switch.
